metadata.description:
This POAP is to celebrate 20 years of making time to get together as a family. The Olson Family has made a tradition of spending time every year together. Planning is rotated through each daughter of Don & Kaye Olson. This POAP was delivered directly to each member of the Olson Family.

The locations include:

Grand Superior Lodge — October 2004
Wisconsin Dells — October 2005
Lanesboro — May 2006
Lundeen Cabin — June 2007
Alexandria — May 2008
Brainerd Lake House — August 2009
Chequamegon — September 2010
Barn on the Bluff — May 2011
Aitkin — September 2012
Lanesboro — May 2013
Grand View Lodge — October 2014
Hibbing — September 2015
Blue Heron Lodge — October 2016
Nicaboyne Lake — October 2017
Park Rapids — October 2018
Amery — August 2019
Madison Lake — October 2020
Birchwood Acres — September 2021
River Lodge — November 2022
Fergus Falls — March 2023
metadata.name: 20 Years of Olson Family Vacations!
